name: Boneheart
description: This dreadnought is the largest known vessel in all Tanares. It terrorized Tanares during the Kemet Invasion but returned to Storm Island after the defeat of the kemets. Many ice elementalists and necromancers infused the warship with many spells, changing it dramatically. Its hull is covered with nearly indestructible permafrost, and its glacial cannon can damage and freeze other vessels, reducing their speed. The vessel is powered by souls, producing haunting war drum sounds that instill fear in opposing crew members, while also emitting light as a powerful lantern. It has many other powers not revealed yet, but some sailors reported a trail of ice that can damage ships that try to pass it. The Captain is the skeletal undead remains of a once highly-experienced captain, improving its speed and maneuverability. Its crew includes hundreds of kemets and undead creatures, some very exotic. This ship is also affected by the Midnight Sun. Sedura has schematics of this vessel and is planning to recruit an experienced adventurers to invade this ship and destroy it.
